articles.title: Lockheed Martin debuts Lamprey undersea mission vehicle
articles.summary: Lockheed Martin has unveiled the Lamprey Multi Mission Autonomous Undersea Vehicle (AUV). This new submersible is designed to significantly enhance the capabilities of US and allied naval forces. The Lamprey AUV aims to provide advanced, autonomous capabilities for various underwater missions, boosting strategic advantage and operational flexibility for modern naval operations.

articles.title: Chidambaram terms Budget as cautious, forgettable; BJP praises Modi for winning taxpayers trust, more capex for infra
articles.summary: The Opposition, led by Congress, has sharply criticized the recent budget, labeling it cautious, parsimonious, and forgettable. They highlighted significant cuts in allocations for key ministries, reportedly due to their failure to effectively utilize previously disbursed funds. This scrutiny underscores parliamentary debate on government financial policy and accountability in public spending, crucial for national governance.

articles.title: Why TCS, CUB, Marico, GRSE, Shree Refrigerations, HAL, Ceigall, Godrej Agrovet, Axiscades, Anant Raj, UVS Hospitality to remain active in today’s trade
articles.summary: Redzone, a manufacturing and supply chain specialist, has strategically partnered with Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) to help mid-market manufacturers modernize operations. This collaboration aims to leverage technology for enhanced efficiency and competitiveness within the industrial sector. Such initiatives are vital for strengthening the nation's manufacturing capabilities, fostering economic growth, and promoting self-reliance, crucial aspects for national development.

articles.title: NOGIG 2026: Teams get wins in table tennis, volleyball
articles.summary: The 20th Nigeria Oil and Gas Industry Games have officially commenced, showcasing competitive spirit among key players in the energy sector. NNPC and TotalEnergies secured notable victories in volleyball matches. Concurrently, Aradel and NLNG emerged as winners in the table tennis competitions. This multi-sport event brings together Nigerian oil and gas companies for camaraderie and athletic challenges, marking an energetic start to the annual games.

articles.title: EU capitals say deleting US tech is not realistic
articles.summary: Estonia's Digital Minister, Liisa-Ly Pakosta, revealed that persistent cyberattacks from Russia have significantly bolstered the nation's digital resilience. These ongoing barrages have inadvertently served as an intense training ground, preparing Estonia for 'literally whatever situation' in the digital realm. This proactive approach has forged a robust digital defense, ensuring preparedness against future cyber threats and showcasing the importance of real-world stress tests for national security.

articles.title: Who owns the moon? No one, despite Fox host Jesse Watters' claim
articles.summary: On January 20, 2026, Fox News host Jesse Watters discussed a claim asserting U.S. ownership of the moon. This conversation reportedly took place in the context of former U.S. President Trump's previous desire to acquire Greenland, an autonomous territory of Denmark. The article snippet introduces a broader geopolitical discussion regarding sovereignty claims over celestial bodies and international territories.

articles.title: Indonesia Data Center Industry Report 2026: Market Share Analysis, Industry Trends & Statistics, Growth Forecasts 2025-2031
articles.summary: A new report forecasts substantial growth for Indonesia's data center market between 2026 and 2031. This comprehensive analysis covers market share, industry trends, and statistics, underscoring the expanding digital infrastructure in Southeast Asia. For an SSB aspirant, understanding such technological advancements is vital, as robust data centers are fundamental for national digital security, economic development, and supporting advanced defence capabilities.
